howToLabel: Replace every "TODO". Label only what the provider's own pages say for the current cycle.
labeledFrom: array of the exact page URLs you read. labeledAt: YYYY-MM-DD.
Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Money is a whole number of US dollars, per year unless noted in notes.
tags.*: object of tag -> "required" or "preferred", e.g. {"women": "required"}. Use {} when none apply.
required = you cannot win without it. preferred = stated preference, priority, or encouragement.
specialCriteria: array of verbatim phrases for anything niche that no field or tag covers. Use [] when none.
If a field cannot express what the source says, label your best fit and explain in notes; that tells us the schema is wrong.
evidence: short quotes from the pages in labeledFrom that support the main values.
Tag strength rule used here: 'required' when it is in the provider's eligibility list; 'preferred' when it is a scored selection criterion, a stated preference, or a typical-winner trait.
Award minimum/maximum hold the smallest and largest amounts stated; whether that is per year or total is in notes.
Yes/no fields (renewable, coversFullCost, essay, recommendations, nomination, interview, fee) are always true or false, never null.

When the provider's pages say nothing about a yes/no field, it is set to the silent default (false) and its path is listed in 'assumed'. need/merit default to 'no' and enrollment to 'either' the same way.
unverified: fields whose source page could not be read. Their value is a placeholder, not a finding.
null is only for values that do not apply or have no number: no minimum GPA, no income ceiling, no fixed dollar amount, no printed date.
gradeLevels: one entry per eligible grade or college year. 'below-grade-9' covers everything before ninth grade.
tracks: when one program is really several scholarships, the main record holds what is common and each track lists only what differs.
application.laterPhases: components that are true but only asked of applicants who advance past the first round.

allowed.eligibility.institutions: array of school names; [] when not tied to specific schools
allowed.eligibility.incomeCeiling: number of dollars, or a short phrase such as "Pell-eligible", or null
allowed.obligation: null, or one sentence, e.g. "One year of DoD civilian service per year funded"
allowed.application.laterPhases: array of components (essay, recommendations, interview, nomination) only required of applicants who advance; [] when everything is due up front
allowed.tracks: array of {name, differs} for programs that are several scholarships under one name; 'differs' holds only the fields that differ from the main record; [] for a single-track program
